title: Semos Villagers Biome Fix
description: Display biome outfits for my villagers packs on 1.21.9+
body:
### <font color="#f02222">!!! This pack is heavy on performances.</font> For now I have sadly no other solution

This pack fix the lack of biome display of my villagers pack on 1.21.9 and up [**[**<font color="#008000">**Hermitcraft Villagers**</font>**]**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hermitcraft-villagers), [**[**<font color="#008000">**Songs Of War Villagers**</font>**]**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/songs-of-war-villagers) and [**[**<font color="#008000">**Alex and Steve Villagers**</font>**]**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alex-and-steve-villagers)

Require version 3.0.4 minimum of Hermitcraft and Songs of War and 6.0.4 of Alex and Steve  
Keep track of what versions of my packs are compatible with wich addon version with this file: [[<font color="#daa520">with this link</font>](https://1drv.ms/x/c/5017ea34619ff0f9/EYARtfWSbd1IsoYWCn7M-CkBHKTpT6MVfBMwl93LenDkAg?e=dbVTA0)]  
The pack order has no importance  
![exapmple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c725691b0af6e7aa8ae378d4f684bb0161d5601.png)

# <font color="#daa520">Compatibility:</font>

- This pack uses the vanilla location of the textures and therefore should be compatible with any ressource pack that change or variate those.
- In addition to vanilla texturing, you can have hats like the farmer or fisherman in the biome outfit. Texture location is the same as the jobs outfit
- Compatible with my [job fix pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/semos-villagers-job-fix)
![job fix + biome fix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/408fb1e71ee314b4c9f907e8cf5c2e3e221e486f.png)


# <font color="#daa520">Advanced Control:</font>

You can toggle the visibility of the biome texture for each entity by putting one of the following in their name:  
```no biome``` ```body biome``` ```left arm biome``` ```right arm biome``` ```head biome``` ```right leg biome``` ```left leg biome```

# <font color="#daa520">Qwerks:</font>

- Head textures are resized to match the player head. So they're mixels.
- Depending of the player face, head equipement like glasses can be far away from the eyes and look funny
- Same goes for the hats

Compatibility example using [Extra Villagers](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/extra-villagers/) from [<font color="#daa520">iHopeICanChangeThis</font>]
![texture variations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fb6c5b6c5321c3652fbb33325dd2d3f99d768e8.png)
